_comment: Grants for the checks investigator. Replace <investigator-principal-sub> with the client id of the agent's login (for example agent:checks-investigator). Post each row with `meho agent grant create`; the README shows the loop. The agent reads freely. Every change waits for a person to approve it.

permissions._purpose: The agent reads the state of the systems it investigates.
The agent lists inventory to find the cause.
If the agent tries a change, MEHO waits until a person approves it. The agent never changes a system alone.
